usage.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(m.session_id, ''), NULLIF(json_extract(m.data, '$.sessionID'), ''), m.id, CAST(m.rowid AS TEXT)) AS sessionId,
  CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(m.time_updated, 0), json_extract(m.data, '$.time.completed'), json_extract(m.data, '$.time.created')) < 1000000000000 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(m.time_updated, 0), json_extract(m.data, '$.time.completed'), json_extract(m.data, '$.time.created')) * 1000 ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(m.time_updated, 0), json_extract(m.data, '$.time.completed'), json_extract(m.data, '$.time.created')) END AS INTEGER) AS timestamp,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(m.data, '$.modelID'), ''), NULLIF(json_extract(m.data, '$.model.id'), ''), 'unknown') AS model,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(m.data, '$.path.cwd'), ''), 'unknown') AS project,
  CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.input'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS inputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.cache.read'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS cachedInputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.cache.write'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS cacheCreationInputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.output'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS outputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.reasoning'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS reasoningOutputTokens
FROM message AS m
WHERE json_valid(m.data) = 1
  AND json_extract(m.data, '$.role') = 'assistant'
  AND (COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.input'), 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.output'), 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.reasoning'), 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.cache.read'), 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(json_extract(m.data, '$.tokens.cache.write'), 0) > 0)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, m.rowid DESC
